basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer from Wichita, Kansas, relatively new to Reddit and exploring its vast communities. I have a deep passion for music and art, particularly interested in discovering hidden gems in the folk genre. During the day, I work at a local design firm, and in the evenings, I enjoy unwinding with a good mystery novel or the latest superhero movie. I'm single and appreciate the flexibility to dive into my hobbies whenever I want. You'll often find me online in the late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a self-taught graphic designer, I have a keen eye for visual aesthetics and an appreciation for the artistic process. My interest in music grew from attending local music festivals and exploring album covers, which led me to discover unique artists like Dave Bixby. I often rely on self-learning through online platforms and community forums to expand my knowledge.
